posts.title: Programming Patterns: Facades
posts.description: When they were introduced, Laravel Facades were one of the most controversial parts of the framework. Nowadays, I don't see many people talking about them anymore. For me, they've become one of my favorite patterns.

posts.title: Programming Patterns: Self-hosting
posts.description: I have been self-hosting for more than a decade. Besides some occasional inconvenience, it turned out to be easier than I thought. Today, I'm going to share my entire setup.

posts.title: Programming Patterns
posts.description: A few years ago, I thought it would be cool to celebrate my 15 years as a Software Developer by sharing 15 programming tips. But then, AI came and changed our jobs forever. Are programming patterns still relevant?
